entries.name: Certified Insurance Service Representative
entries.definition: A designation from the National Alliance for Insurance Education & Research for customer-service staff in insurance agencies.

entries.name: Certified IRB Manager
entries.definition: A credential for managers of institutional review boards, the committees that review the ethics of research involving people.

entries.name: Certified Irrigation Designer
entries.definition: A certification from the Irrigation Association for designers of irrigation systems.

entries.name: Certified LabVIEW Developer
entries.definition: A certification from National Instruments showing that someone can design, build and debug well-structured LabVIEW applications.

entries.name: Certified Managed Care Nurse
entries.definition: A certification from the American Board of Managed Care Nursing for nurses who work in managed care.

entries.name: Certified Management Accountant
entries.definition: A certification from the Institute of Management Accountants for accountants skilled in financial planning, analysis and control.

entries.name: Certified Medical Assistant
entries.definition: A certification from the American Association of Medical Assistants for medical assistants who pass its examination.

entries.name: Certified Medical Billing and Coding Specialist
entries.definition: A certification for people who prepare healthcare claims and assign diagnosis and procedure codes.

entries.name: Certified Medical Laboratory Assistant
entries.definition: A certification for assistants who collect, prepare and process specimens in a medical laboratory.

entries.name: Certified Medical-Surgical Registered Nurse
entries.definition: A certification for registered nurses who work in medical-surgical nursing, awarded by the Medical-Surgical Nursing Certification Board.

entries.name: Certified Music Therapist
entries.definition: A credential showing that a music therapist has met professional certification requirements.

entries.name: Certified Nephrology Nurse
entries.definition: A certification for registered nurses who care for people with kidney disease, awarded by the Nephrology Nursing Certification Commission.

entries.name: Certified Network Defense Architect
entries.definition: An EC-Council certification for professionals who design and defend secure computer networks.

entries.name: Certified Neuroscience Registered Nurse
entries.definition: A certification for registered nurses who care for patients with neurological conditions, awarded by the American Board of Neuroscience Nursing.

entries.name: Certified Novell Salesperson
entries.definition: A Novell certification for sales staff who sell Novell products and solutions.

entries.name: Certified Nurse Manager and Leader
entries.definition: A certification for nurses in management and leadership roles, awarded by the AONL Credentialing Center.

entries.name: Certified Nurse-Midwife
entries.definition: A credential for advanced practice nurses trained in midwifery, awarded by the American Midwifery Certification Board.

entries.name: Certified Nursing Assistant
entries.definition: A state-recognised certification for nursing assistants who give basic bedside care under the direction of nurses.

entries.name: Certified Occupancy Specialist
entries.definition: A housing-industry credential for staff who determine eligibility and manage occupancy in subsidised housing programmes.

entries.name: Certified Occupational Health Nurse
entries.definition: A certification for registered nurses who specialise in occupational and workplace health, awarded by the American Board for Occupational Health Nurses.

entries.name: Certified Ostomy Care Nurse
entries.definition: A certification for registered nurses who specialise in the care of people with ostomies, awarded by the Wound, Ostomy and Continence Nursing Certification Board.

entries.name: Certified Outpatient Coder
entries.definition: An AAPC certification for coders who assign diagnosis and procedure codes to outpatient hospital and facility claims.

entries.name: Certified Patient Care Technician
entries.definition: A certification for technicians who give hands-on patient care in hospitals and similar settings.

entries.name: Certified Pediatric Emergency Nurse
entries.definition: A nursing certification from the Board of Certification for Emergency Nursing for nurses who care for children in emergencies.

entries.name: Certified Pediatric Hematology Oncology Nurse
entries.definition: A certification for registered nurses who care for children with cancer and blood disorders, awarded by the Oncology Nursing Certification Corporation.

entries.name: Certified Pediatric Nurse
entries.definition: A certification for registered nurses who care for children, awarded by the Pediatric Nursing Certification Board.

entries.name: Certified Perioperative Nurse (CNOR)
entries.definition: A certification for registered nurses who work in the operating room, awarded by the Competency and Credentialing Institute.

entries.name: Certified Physician Practice Manager
entries.definition: An AAPC certification for managers of physician and medical group practices.

entries.name: Certified Plastic Surgical Nurse
entries.definition: A certification for registered nurses in plastic and reconstructive surgery, awarded by the Plastic Surgical Nursing Certification Board.

entries.name: Certified Pool & Spa Operator
entries.definition: A certification from the Pool & Hot Tub Alliance for people who operate and maintain swimming pools and spas.

entries.name: Certified Professional Biller
entries.definition: An AAPC certification for medical billers who prepare, submit and follow up healthcare claims.

entries.name: Certified Professional Compliance Officer
entries.definition: An AAPC certification for people who oversee compliance programmes in healthcare organisations.

entries.name: Certified Professional Geologist
entries.definition: A professional certification for geologists from the American Institute of Professional Geologists.

entries.name: Certified Professional in Healthcare Information and Management Systems
entries.definition: A HIMSS certification for professionals in healthcare information and management systems.

entries.name: Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality
entries.definition: A certification for professionals who work on quality improvement and patient safety in healthcare.

entries.name: Certified Professional in Healthcare Risk Management
entries.definition: A certification for professionals who manage risk and patient safety in healthcare, awarded by the American Hospital Association Certification Center.

entries.name: Certified Professional Manager
entries.definition: A management certification awarded by the Institute of Certified Professional Managers.

entries.name: Certified Professional Medical Services Management
entries.definition: A certification for professionals who manage medical staff services such as provider credentialing and privileging.

entries.name: Certified Professional of Occupancy
entries.definition: A housing-industry credential for staff who handle eligibility and occupancy in affordable and subsidised housing.

entries.name: Certified Projects Director
entries.definition: The top level (Level A) of the IPMA four-level project management certification, for directors of large portfolios and programmes.
